strongest_angle: Recent historical analysis of Nicolas Flamel's will at the Musée de Cluny reveals that his legendary status as an alchemist was a later fabrication, contrasting with his actual life as a wealthy medieval Parisian.

key_facts.fact: The Musée de Cluny in Paris is hosting an exhibition from 13 October 2026 to 24 January 2027 that examines the historical reality of Nicolas Flamel.
key_facts.source_name: Musée de Cluny - musée national du Moyen Âge

key_facts.fact: A manuscript purported to be the last will and testament of Nicolas Flamel was originally dated to 1414, though scholars believe it was likely composed in the 18th century.
Writers and scientists have been fascinated by the myth of Nicolas and Pernelle Flamel for 600 years, according to reporting by the BBC.
